svg.title: Data Center Docket: eleven issue-first pitch decisions
svg.desc: Eleven proposed audience lenses show the question and decision path for community and labor, competition, CAP, municipal procurement, insurance, repair, compute markets, spatial media, authorized traffic stewardship, cooperative capacity and workforce disclosure. Cards distinguish public records, linked instruments and separately authorized evidence. No production capability or measured result is claimed.
svg.text: One case. Eleven ways to act.
